task: Act as Review over the exact frozen runtime and the assigned facts. Return the selected owner or one terminal report. Cite the supplied fact or simulated observation used for every decision.
authority: Read-only review judgment only. The caller owns Spec, Charter, fixed point, risk, repair, residual acceptance, mutation, and successor snapshots.
initial_state: Only the assigned source facts and simulated observations exist. Do not invent repository state, sources, proof, or authority.
tools_and_operations: Read the exact runtime and assigned fixture. Simulate named read-only Git and source observations. Write only the assigned disposable capture.
mutation_boundary: No repository, index, worktree, tracker, connector, remote, installation, repair, or successor mutation. Only the assigned disposable capture may be written.
requested_output: Name route, fixed point and snapshot tuple or blocker, covered and skipped work, separate Standards and Spec results, admitted findings if any, drift, terminal status, and the three authority lines.
